rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 – Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI-U increase and may not adjust rents of tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under Costa-Hawkins.
rules.key_value: 65% of CPI increase; 1.0% for 2026 (CPI rose 1.5% from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025)
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.status_basis: Adopted October 16, 2025; increase allowed no earlier than January 1, 2026

exempt_if.name: costa_hawkins_new_tenancy
exempt_if.text: tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and rent was set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units under the Berkeley rent stabilization ordinance whose landlords are eligible for the increase.
coverage.exemptions_summary: The 2026 AGA does not adjust rents for tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins.

rules.quoted_span: The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5% as posted by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
